items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: my mother listened to jazz, to Basie... I wouldn’t say I liked it very much, but I got it natural.

ctx.x: What, when you were young, how did music grab you?

First of all I’ve been playing piano all my life. So I have memories as a little child playing by ear the children’s songs. And play by ear, that’s what I still do. So my mother listened to jazz, to Basie, Louis Armstrong, Ellington, those kind of things. So I got it by the record. I wouldn’t say I liked it very much, but I got it natural. I started playing jazz when I was maybe 15, 16. Before that I had some classical education. I played some pop, rock and blues, but when I was 15 or 16 I just started playing…
Why wasn’t it natural for you to play The Beatles?
